title: MarkSafe document template
description: Template for new documents: input fields for the form, a Markdown body with {{placeholders}} and the output file name. Placeholders: {{id}}, {{id|yaml}} (YAML-safe scalar), {{id|list}} (YAML list, for multiselect) and {{id|ref}} (docref: "ID (Titel)"). Fields with "target": "frontmatter" are written into the front matter. For documents of the MLC Markdown Extension (category "mlc") id, version and title live there (doc_id, version, title); the body uses the document variables {{doc_id}}, {{version}}, {{title}}, which stay in the file.

body.description: Markdown file next to this schema, with the document text.

file.description: Suggested output file name, with placeholders, e.g. "{{doc_id}}.md".

category.description: Group in the dialog: documents of the MLC Markdown Extension or general Markdown. Default: mlc when a field writes doc_id or is a refno.

id.description: Name of the placeholder {{id}}, or the front matter key with target "frontmatter".

type.description: hour is the same as time (HH:MM).

default.description: Preset value; a list for multiselect.

options.description: Choices for select/multiselect: a list, or the name of a shared list (event_kinds).

prefix.description: refno: prefix of the document ID, e.g. FB. docref: only documents with this prefix.

area.description: refno: id of the field holding the area (QM, KAL …) for the suggestion.

multiple.description: docref: several documents may be chosen.

target.description: The value goes into the front matter under the field id (MLC documents: doc_id, version, title, description, event_kinds) instead of a placeholder.
